# Nomor 1
```{r}
set.seed(123)
x1 <- rbinom(1000, size = 20, prob = 0.4)

cat("Secara empiris, Mean = ", mean(x1))
cat("\n")
cat("Secara empiris, Variansi = ", var(x1))
cat("\n")
cat("Secara teori, Mean = ", 20*0.4)
cat("\n")
cat("Secara teori, Variansi = ", 20*0.4*0.6)
```

# Nomor 2
```{r fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
set.seed(123)
x2 <- rnorm(1000)
y <- x2^2

hist(y, probability = TRUE, breaks = 30, col = "lightblue",
     main = "Histogram y = x^2")

cat("Distribusi dari Y adalah Chi-square")
```

# Nomor 3
```{r fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
set.seed(123)
u <- runif(1000)
x3 <- sqrt(u)

u # Semua nilai sampel
hist(x3, probability = TRUE, breaks = 30, col = "lightblue",
     main = "Sampel menggunakan metode invers")
```
